paper: B. Kibler, J. Fatome, C. Finot, G. Millot, F. Dias, G. Genty, N. Akhmediev, J. M. Dudley, The Peregrine soliton in nonlinear fibre optics, Nat. Phys. 6, 790 (2010)
description: Breather-formalism excitation of the Peregrine soliton in an HNLF: the exact Akhmediev-breather (Eq. 2) family is propagated with the NLSE engine, its a->1/2 Peregrine limit (Eq. 3) is asserted, and the a=0.42 experimental deck (xi=2.5, P0=0.30 W, f_mod=241 GHz) is reproduced dimensionally.
